patthana23.53:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.53:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.53:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika namaggārammaṇattike sanidassanattika maggārammaṇattikaṃ
